summary: Iteration 112: Multi-Target Automation Rules Architecture Testing. All 16 backend tests passed (100%). The new multi-target architecture (1 source panel -> multiple target panels) is working correctly. Backend CRUD operations with targets[] array validated. context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 112 tested the new multi-target automation architecture. Key changes from iteration 111: Rules now have targets[] array instead of single target fields. Each target has its own target_panel_id, action_type, field_mappings, field_visibility. Backend validates: empty targets returns 422, invalid target_panel_id returns 400/404, create_record without field_mappings returns 400, update_record without update_field/update_value_from returns 400. System module IDs (inventory, invoices, buyers, suppliers, etc.) are accepted as target_panel_id. Frontend requires Firebase auth - cannot test UI with Playwright without valid Firebase credentials.
features_tested: GET /api/business-tools/automation/rules returns rules with targets[] array and enriched panel names
PUT /api/business-tools/automation/rules/{id} updates rule name, is_active, and targets
System module IDs (inventory) accepted as target_panel_id

CreateRuleRequest.name: string (required)
CreateRuleRequest.condition: { field, operator, value } (optional, required for condition_based)
